title: Profile: buyer.search.nearby
description: Canonical buyer query profile for nearby geo-aware listing search.
text:
# buyer.search.nearby

TL;DR:
- Use this profile for location-based buyer search.
- It requires meta.latLon and usually uses filter.range in kilometers.

This profile is for 'near me' or 'within X km' style search.
whenToUse: Distance or travel range is part of the request.
recommended: Use sort.geo when geo ordering matters.
avoid: Do not use filter.range without meta.latLon.
Do not explain listing.distance when the query had no geo context.
exampleInterpretation: Returned items are within the requested range from the supplied geo context.
listing.distance is relevant and expressed in kilometers.
